notes.title: Patch update: 1.2.11
notes.notes:
Hi [b][i]Gomoku players[/i][/b],

At the end of November, we brought you the following updates:
[list]
[*] The time limit for each turn in online matches has been extended (from 30 seconds to 60 seconds)
[*] You can add opponents as [b]Steam [/b]friends in online matches
[*] Added "Try Play" feature in the Replay mode
[*] Mouse wheel support in the Replay mode
[*] You can choose different scenes to play the challenges
[*] Added some interactive elements in different scenes (share your findings in the comment section)
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/0357499957130b9dc629d8ea0bb2395f030e4bc5.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/a8111d847b4f8e50713f60f54b180c752b96e072.jpg[/img]

If you want to find other Gomoku players to play with, join our [url=http://dsc.gg/gomoku_lets_go]Discord [/url]community.

Thank you again for the support!

notes.title: Patch update: 1.2.3
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Update 1.2.3 has been released!

We have added a real-time analysis, which will mark some recommended positions and show the winning rate of each position. Combined with the Replay feature, we hope to help players improve their Gomoku skills.

[list]
[*] In practice mode, added [b][u]katagomo analysis[/u][/b] (The game will automatically adapt to the GPU or CPU version based on the computer specs)
[*] Added [b][u]board coordinates[/u][/b]
[*] Re-organized options in the Settings
[*] Improved the light and shadow of the Washitsu scene
[*] Added restrictions information in online matches
[*] Fixed the problem of "getting stuck when entering the scene in online mode"
[*] Added a click effect to the cursor
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/6b5ab135affbf7773fe87ae36b6a53140746fbae.png[/img]

If you encounter any problems or have any concerns, please leave a comment or review. Thank you again for the support!

notes.title: Patch update: 1.1.17 + New "Go/Weiqi/Baduk" Game Info
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have brought the following updates in this new patch:
[list]
[*] Optimized 3d models in all scenes
[*] Added [b]Reset Rank Score[/b] option, and there will be no more negative scores
[*] Visualized the placement position for the next move (screenshot below)
[*] In-game [b]Mouse Sensitivity Adjustment[/b] options
[*] Reworked the animation in the living room scene 
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/a7019b13639a657ff116411eb5793eef3bddf1ed.png[/img]

Moreover, we are teaming up with [b]Papergames[/b] to bring more people into our online games.

By the way, our new [b]Go / Weiqi / Baduk[/b] game is under development. We will release a free demo version at the end of this year. Below are a few screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/0081b1f6a06371ec769d805ee93549491fdd0167.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/27b99e41e520c647547f21db0aa6d7eac8cf6744.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch update: 1.1.11
notes.notes:
Greetings!

The updates this week are as follows:
[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial Mode[/b] has been added, hope it can help beginners learn the basic rules and common terms of Gomoku
[*] Added 14 brand new background music
[*] New emojis for online matches
[*] In the real-time challenge, you can match games with or without Restriction (Forbidden Moves) at the same time
[*] The answers to all Endgame challenges can be found in the following guide
[/list]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2587942954
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/a567fb6caf5e26b4f0deee4e0cdf4f2bab70826c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch update: 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

This week we brought the following updates:

[list]
[*] Brand new 10 challenge levels
[*] Players can communicate in online matches through simple emojis
[*] Updated and improved the [b]Replay[/b] feature
[*] A countdown sound effect has been added to the last 10 seconds of each turn in online matches
[*] Added "[b]Show Move Number[/b]" in game accessibility settings
[*] The leaderboard shows the [b]top 100[/b] players
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/886b6267c0a4ab8e4c69b31c67f2339de43d577c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/d18fc578c3943a6fc2f18bb8364f02ad404e85c5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/348a3f4c42a9a3a9c9d651a020aa2fc63c4a0cca.jpg[/img]

We will post the solutions of all challenges in the next few days. 

Also, due to personal reasons, we will be a bit slow to reply to comments and update the game next week. Sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Patch update: 1.0.21
notes.notes:
Greetings!

It's another week, this time we bring the following updates:

[list]
[*] Added [b]Replay[/b] feature, online and local matches will be automatically saved and can be re-played
[*] Online matches fix
[list]
[*] Won't stuck in "Waiting for the opponent to respond" state
[*] If someone turns on real-time challenge while in standby (or afk), it will automatically turn off
[/list]
[*] The option of [b]Request a Draw[/b] has been added to the online matches
[*] The AI ​​used in the Endgame challenge mode is changed to [b]Master[/b]
[*] Changed the English title to "Gomoku Let's Go"
[*] Added two background music
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/8f7b952cc74d6834b9720ace204fbd9eec75fc2d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/f83a744453709ce2052d49700010620d724b1cd3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/4640cf0861991abf906cea667ee74db2277dafa2.jpg[/img]
The tutorial mode is still in full swing, and it will probably take another 1-2 weeks. Later, we will add some simple communication emoticons to the online matches.

If you have any suggestions for new features or find any bugs, please leave a message below or post to the topic in discussion section. We will reply as soon as possible. Thank you all!

notes.title: Patch update: 1.0.15
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Update 1.0.15 has just been released, here are some of the major changes:

[list]
[*] A new AI ([b]Top Player[/b]) has been added, which is mainly for Gomoku/Gobang masters. The thinking time will be much longer at the beginning stage, and each turn will take about 8-10 seconds.
[*] Increase the maximum Rank Score to 3000
[*] Added an adjustable time limit per turn in Friends Play mode
[*] Added right-click undo 
[*] Added a sound effect when the notification pops up for an online match request
[*] Resolution bug fix
[*] Reworked Korean title
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/61ba552c8713a70b3ebaece269c371096dba3f2f.jpg[/img]

We were working on the tutorial mode and the replay function last week, hoping to better guide newcomers to play Gobang. The localization work is now ongoing, and it is expected to be officially released in 2-3 weeks.

Again, thanks for all the comments and reviews!

notes.title: Patch update: 1.0.10
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

A couple of updates have been made in the past few days:
[list]
[*] After the online match is over, if both players agree, you can exchange hands and rematch
[*] Included 5 new background music
[*] Fix 4-4 forbidden hand issue
[*] Reworked in-game button icons
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/c7bcbb88d7196fbc92747ec144654b44d3241e05.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/ab5c56d10ffb56b5b4998e2018f54ee495040d96.jpg[/img]

For the next update, we will improve the functionalities in Friends Play mode  (e.g. adding an adjustable time limit for each round). Stay tuned!

If you have any suggestions, feel free to write a review or leave a comment below, we will check each of them. Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Patch update: 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Just a quick note, we just released a new update

[list]
[*] When you finish a local match, you can decide to rematch or exit the game by yourself instead of going back to main menu automatically.
[*] During online matches, both sides have 30 seconds to think each round, and the opponent will automatically win the game if you time out, and vice versa.
[*] Real-time display of the number of online players who can be challenged
[*] When a new challenge notification is coming, both players can know the other's decision in real-time (reject or accept the game)
[*] Optimized the Library scene
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/c5c6bee2ac5ad231559812c0dde7a2fa7f1c1b46.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/04fa6008824b7ec597426072c10578e58eaf03e9.jpg[/img]

Also, we will have a major update next week:
[list]
[*] After the online match is over, if both players agree, you can exchange hands and rematch
[*] Add some simple emojis to communicate with each other in online matches
[*] Add new Endgame challenge levels
[/list]

As usual, if you have any suggestions, feel free to write a review or leave a comment below, we will check each of them. Thank you again for your support!

notes.title: Patch update: 1.0.2
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you very much for all the support of [b]"Gobang Let's go"[/b] since its release! We have received many feedback and suggestions.

The details of the update are as follows:
[list]
[*] Add Forbidden Hand Hints
[*] Update [b]Online Challenge Mode[/b] Matching mechanism
[*] The position of Gomoku bowls changes according to the player's disc color
[*] Bug fix (mainly the statistical data problem)
[/list]

We will continue to improve our game in the future. Also, a small tip: when Online Challenge mode is on, you can still play matches with AI or Endgame challenges, and no need to wait in the main screen all the time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39932999/dba7b8714ded2b728c7bffd8cb36424753ca543d.jpg[/img]
